derivation.convention: Primitive-cell momenta, not m=2 supercell momenta. f(q)=1+exp(i*q_x)+exp(-i*q_y), h(f)=[[0,f],[conj(f),0]]. In the paired momentum basis P0=[I;I]/sqrt(2). theta is the same exp(-theta*H) convention as the entropy protocol.
derivation.stripe_x: Pair q=(0,delta), q+Q=(pi,delta), Q=(pi,0): f1=2+exp(-i*delta), f2=exp(-i*delta). Their phase difference is 2*delta/3+O(delta^3). The negative-overlap singular value is |sin(Delta_phi/4)|=|delta|/6+O(delta^3). The two-particle GS amplitude has magnitude |sin(Delta_phi/2)|/2 ~ |delta|/6, and the lowest excited Slater amplitude has magnitude |cos(Delta_phi/2)|/2 ~ 1/2. Its energy exceeds the GS by 2|f2|=2, so the leading excited/GS amplitude ratio is 3*exp(-2*theta)/|delta|. At large theta and small delta this gives n_positive ~ 1/[1+(delta/(3*exp(-2*theta)))^2]. Other Slater sectors provide subleading corrections.
derivation.checker: Pair q=(pi+delta,0), q+Q=(delta,pi) modulo 2pi, Q=(pi,pi): f1=2-exp(i*delta), f2=exp(i*delta). The negative-overlap singular value is |delta|/2+O(delta^3). Both positive energies approach 1 and both negative energies approach -1. The leading rank-one graph singular value is 2*exp(-2*theta)/|delta|, giving n_positive ~ 1/[1+(delta/(2*exp(-2*theta)))^2].
derivation.nonzero_graph: For delta!=0, A=V_minus^dagger P0 is invertible, B=V_plus^dagger P0, X=exp(-theta E_plus) B inv(A) exp(theta E_minus). QR([I;X]) constructs the exact occupied span without unstable large exponential columns. n_positive is the total occupation of the two positive-energy eigenstates.
derivation.exact_zero: No inverse of A is used at delta=0. Stripe x has one supported negative sigma_x branch and one supported positive branch, evolved with explicit normalized weights 1 and exp(-2*theta); its limit occupies energy -3 and +1. Checker has identical sigma_x blocks and an invariant initial occupied projector, with one negative and one positive particle. Thus n_positive=1 for every finite theta and its strict limit. Local overlap rank is 1/2; in the full m=2 block the extra folded sector yields the previously audited rank 3/4.
derivation.grid_condition: Resolving this local momentum layer requires (2*pi/L)/(C*exp(-2*theta)) << 1, C=3 for stripe x and C=2 for checker. Its local crossover time is theta_cross(L)=0.5*log(C*L/(2*pi)); a well-resolved layer needs theta below that value with a sufficient margin. Merely theta/L << 1 does not imply this condition.

interpretation: This is a local, gapped folded-mode mechanism for nonuniform projection near an exact overlap zero. It does not introduce a new Dirac node.
The shrinking momentum width is measured on specified cuts only. Its inverse is not asserted to be the unique correlation length of the full many-body state.

It supplies a reason why theta/L alone need not control finite-size effects for these alternating initial states. No total D, entropy scaling coefficient, or quantitative attribution of the observed D anomaly is derived here.
All calculations are at beta=0 before measurement; finite-beta behavior is not established by this local diagnostic.

The relative-width grid and tolerances test the asymptotic local formula. Nearest-grid rows at L144/180 are diagnostics with their own recorded asymptotic errors, not part of that asymptotic error gate.
